name: I Dreamt of Something Lost
source:
I DREAMT OF SOMETHING LOST is a short interactive narrative about data, grief, and memory. You take control of Jules as they sit down to their desktop computer and discover a new message from their ex-girlfriend - who died a year ago to the day.

[From [url=https://bodypoetic.itch.io/i-dreamt-of-something-lost]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我梦见失去的东西》是一部关于数据、悲伤和记忆的简短互动叙述。你控制着朱尔斯，他们坐在台式电脑前，发现了一条来自他们前女友的新消息——她的前女友一年前去世了。

[来自[url=https://bodypoetic.itch.io/i-dreamt-of-something-lost]itch.io[/url]]
